_comment: Maps each PDF in this directory to the page it was downloaded from. A PDF with no entry here is SKIPPED, because rows parsed from it would carry no source_url and would fail validation. Set "parse": false when the PDF is the PROVENANCE for manually-transcribed rows rather than something to auto-parse.

Courses_Of_Study.pdf.parse_note: 208 pages covering every programme at the institute. Auto-parsing the table layout would pull course rows from Computer Science, Electrical, Materials, Mechatronics and the postgraduate programmes into a dataset the brief requires to cover ONE programme in depth. The Mechanical programme rows were therefore transcribed by hand from pages 32-33 and the course-description section, and this PDF is recorded as their provenance. Run tools/crosscheck_pdf.py to verify the transcription against the PDF mechanically.
